_note: Hidden stats show up only as symptoms in a school's daily report. Each key is a condition the engine checks.
low_morale: Faculty have begun eating lunch in their cars.
Office hours have been replaced by an out-of-office message.
Three professors were seen updating their LinkedIn profiles during commencement rehearsal.
The faculty senate meeting reached quorum only after counting the portraits.
high_bureaucracy: Requests for new forms now require a form.
The committee on committees has formed a subcommittee.
A student waited six hours to drop a class and is now enrolled in two more.
The org chart has been printed on a scroll.
high_lawsuits: Lawyers have been spotted in the dining hall, eating free.
The general counsel has stopped returning calls and started returning subpoenas.
Every campus email now ends with a 400-word disclaimer.
high_chaos: Nobody is sure which building is the library this week.
The bell tower has started ringing in binary.
Two different presidents gave this year's welcome address. Both were confident.
low_satisfaction: Students have begun referring to the campus as "the facility."
The student newspaper is now printed entirely in complaint.
Tour guides walk backwards to keep an eye on the students.
